runtime: ECMAScript module; no host state, DOM, network or filesystem I/O

equations: P_DC = P_input for motor+inverter; P_input/eta_inv for positive motor-only input; P_input*eta_inv for negative motor-only input
assumptions: Native complete numeric-loss motor package with independently supplied profile
Signed shaft/DC power: positive motoring consumption; negative generation
No reflection of positive torque data into regeneration
Continuous rating by default; peak queries require explicit exposure within source duty
Regeneration uses native envelope and DC-budget bisection; remaining braking is friction braking

configuration.peakExposureS: required elapsed peak-duty exposure for a peak query

implementationAuthority: SI adapter uses the canonical ice-core numerical kernels; all application copies are verified distributions.
status: Adopted by Automobile and ICE through the common pinned bundle.
limitations: Complete profile required; standalone Bolt loss map is not an installable motor component
Combined mapped losses cannot be separated into motor and inverter heat
No cold/thermal/current-voltage state model beyond supplied profile limits
Peak-duty recovery and repeated thermal duty are not modeled
Content hashes identify retained bytes; no publisher authentication

Battery terminal voltage is checked only when supplied and the package declares a voltage envelope; otherwise voltage compatibility remains unassessed. Loss grids remain at their source voltage/temperature.
